# YakuBus / Yakushima Bus / 屋久島バス / 屋久岛公交

> Independent trilingual transport tool for Yakushima, Kagoshima, Japan. Not the bus or ferry operator.

## Pages

- [Yakushima Bus Timetable & Service Notices | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/): Find the next bus between Miyanoura Port, Yakushima Airport and Anbo. Check weekday, Saturday and holiday schedules, official PDF revisions, suspension notices, fares and trailhead connections. Independent travel tool.
- [Yakushima Bus Map, Fares & Day Passes | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/fare/): View official Yakushima bus route maps and fare PDFs. Select stops for adult one-way fare estimates, day pass information and suspended-route notices. Fare-table revisions are separate from timetable revisions.
- [Yakushima Ferry & Jetfoil Times from Kagoshima | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/ferry/): Compare Toppy/Rocket jetfoils and Ferry Yakushima 2 from Kagoshima and Ibusuki. Check date-specific seasonal schedules, fares, planned cancellations, official booking links and onward buses from Miyanoura or Anbo.
- [Yakushima Map: Hot Springs, Shops & Bus Stops | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/map/): Explore Yakushima hot springs, beaches, historic sites, supermarkets, pharmacies, ATMs and bus stops. Read place descriptions, open navigation and follow links to bus timetables. Check road notices for mountain destinations.
- [Yakushima Travel & Experiences: Hikes, Stays & Transport | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/trekking/): Explore Yakushima island tours, guided experiences, hot-spring stays and hiking routes. Plan with official sources, road notices, bus connections and practical travel guides.
- [Yakushima without a car: plan two nights and three days | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/without-car/): Start with your arrival port, accommodation and one main activity. This guide explains the planning order; use your travel date to look up departures.
- [About YakuBus: Yakushima Transport Sources & Contact](https://yakushimabus.com/about/): YakuBus is an independent Yakushima bus, fare and ferry information site. Find official operator PDFs, tourism association sources and contact details. Planned timetables and temporary service suspensions are recorded separately.
- [Miyanoura or Anbo? Choose a base without a car | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/yakushima-where-to-stay/): Compare your arrival port, early starts and dinner arrangements before choosing a hotel. An area name alone does not tell you how easy a stay will be.
- [Rain in Yakushima: alternatives and changing plans | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/yakushima-rainy-day/): Check the roads, transport and activity location first. Keep one indoor option or a plan near your accommodation instead of filling every day.
- [A half-day in Kagoshima before or after Yakushima | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/kagoshima-half-day/): Stay by the waterfront or choose one city sight. Work out your usable time after luggage, travel and boarding formalities before deciding how far to go.
- [Yakushima & Kagoshima Travel Guides | YakuBus](https://yakushimabus.com/guides/): Practical Yakushima and Kagoshima guides: plan a car-free stay, choose a base, prepare for rain and use a half-day around your ferry journey. Official references and transport tools.

## Data scope and dates

Timetable revision: 2026-10-01; fare revision: 2024-03-01; checked 2026-10-24; review due 2026-10-31. Recheck official information before travel.
All times use Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+9). Choose the actual travel day and check each conditional service note.
The internal display horizon is a conservative review policy, not an official PDF expiry date.
Japanese, Simplified Chinese and English are selected using ?lang=ja, ?lang=zh or ?lang=en.

## Recorded service notices — recheck before travel

These are dated source records, not live confirmation. An overdue review does not establish that a suspended route has reopened.

- Some town roads close for bridge inspections Oct 16–28, including access toward Senpiro Falls. Check the official notice for each location, date and detour. Checked 2026-10-09; review due 2026-10-29; notice scope 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-28. Source: https://yakukan.jp/topics/19545.html
- Taneyaku announced the Shiratani bus service resumed from Oct 18. Taiko-iwa and Bugyo-sugi routes are accessible, with some other trails still closed. Check buses, roads and trails separately before travel. Checked 2026-10-24; review due 2026-10-31; notice scope 2026-10-18 to until further notice. Source: https://www.iwasaki-corp.com/
- Matsubanda’s Shiratani timetable still shows suspension. This is a different operator from the reopened Taneyaku service and does not mean every Matsubanda route is suspended. Checked 2026-10-24; review due 2026-10-31; notice scope 2026-10-24 to until further notice. Source: https://yakushima.co.jp/route_bus/
